account: Today seems ordinary so far; I have not confirmed any problem or unusual scheme. During my ten o'clock market walk, townsfolk reported that the baker had carried a sack of wheat at the bakery, and later a sack of bread at the inn. Those are reports, not things I directly witnessed. They may simply reflect baking and supplying bread to the inn; I do not know the purpose for certain. I bought one loaf at the bakery stall without difficulty. The secretary reported no correspondence or town news this morning and is keeping my appointment book safe. My tea invitation initially lacked an exact address, but the neighbour has now personally confirmed three o'clock at the east-bank cottage at (16, -60, 105), near the ferry landing. I am home for the noon lunch appointment, with town accounts at the office due at thirteen hundred, tea at fifteen hundred, and another office appointment at sixteen thirty.
